about.title: About
about.whatIsThisDesc: {title} is a free, interactive web map for the Croatian Long Distance Trail (CLDT). Use it to explore the route, check elevation profiles, measure distances, and share your position with others. It works on desktop and mobile browsers.
about.aboutCldtDesc: The Croatian Long Distance Trail is a national long-distance hiking trail spanning over 2,200 km across Croatia, from Ilok in the east to Prevlaka in the south. It passes through mountains, coastal regions, and cultural landmarks. The trail is maintained by the <link>{associationLink}</link>.

mapFeaturesList.trail: Click the route or elevation chart to see distance and elevation at any point
mapFeaturesList.elevation: Elevation profile chart; hover to preview on the map, click to pin a point; with Surface or SAC trail style active, the hover tooltip also shows the OSM surface or difficulty label at that km
mapFeaturesList.ruler: Distance ruler to measure segments between two points
mapFeaturesList.distanceEtaOverlay: Distance & ETA overlay - live HUD chip with distance traveled and remaining, elevation gain/loss remaining, and ETA to trail end or the active ruler section
mapFeaturesList.layers: Multiple map layers (standard, topo, hiking, satellite, terrain, cycling, Croatia Topo, dark), plus an optional Waymarked Trails overlay of OSM hiking routes (Settings toggle, online only)
mapFeaturesList.location: Optional location tracking to see your position on the trail
mapFeaturesList.share: Share links carry your full map view - position, direction, units, layers, ruler range, stage plan, waypoints, and journal. The share button opens a QR code panel and copy link; compact short links (/s/'{'code'}') apply when online and enabled in Settings
mapFeaturesList.darkMode: Dark mode and battery saver options
mapFeaturesList.offlineMaps: Offline maps - pre-cache the trail corridor for use without a signal
mapFeaturesList.gpxExport: GPX export - download the full trail or a ruler-selected segment as a .gpx file for GPS devices
mapFeaturesList.printExport: Print and export - save the current map view as a PDF or PNG image
mapFeaturesList.weather: Current weather at your trail location - temperature, wind, precipitation probability, sunrise/sunset; 12-hour hourly forecast with precipitation bars and best-window hint (DHMZ + Open-Meteo)
mapFeaturesList.trailNotices: Regional trail condition notices - dismissible banners with alerts for current conditions on the trail
mapFeaturesList.seasonalStatus: Seasonal trail status - curated map layer of warnings, closures, and seasonal conditions sourced from DHMZ, HGSS, HPS, and Croatian national parks; severity-colored chip markers along the trail at the centre of each affected range; hover or click a chip to highlight the affected stretch and open a detail popout with severity, recommended gear, and a link to the original notice; data refreshed by running `npm run update-seasonal`
mapFeaturesList.mineAreas: Mine-suspected areas - official MUP/HCR polygons near the trail with warning chips and GPS-triggered banners (non-dismissible inside a polygon, dismissible within 500 m); on by default, fully offline once cached; informational only - always obey on-site signage
mapFeaturesList.severeWeather: Severe weather alerts - Meteoalarm CAP warnings for Croatia as color-coded map polygons with GPS-triggered banners; non-dismissible for red/severe warnings; data refreshed every 15 minutes
mapFeaturesList.radar: Precipitation radar overlay - animated RainViewer radar with past and nowcast frames, play/pause controls, and colour legend
mapFeaturesList.sunsetPosition: Sunset/sunrise position - projects where you will be on the trail at sunset and sunrise based on your current pace; toggleable markers on the polyline
mapFeaturesList.stagePlanner: Multi-day stage planner - split any trail range into daily stages by distance or time, view per-stage elevation and ETA stats, export individual stages as GPX files, or export all stages as a strip-map PDF
mapFeaturesList.gpxImport: GPX track import - drag and drop (or pick) a recorded GPX file to overlay your actual hike on the map; compare your track against the official trail with stats on distance, pace, elapsed time, max deviation, and % of trail covered
mapFeaturesList.emergency: Emergency 112 panel - long-press the red SOS button (bottom-right) for an offline-first panel showing your GPS coordinates, Plus Code, trail section and km, and the bearing and distance to the nearest road access and HGSS mountain rescue station; when online, a readable address line is looked up and can be copied; copy any field to the clipboard and hand off to your phone dialer (Call 112) or maps app (Open in maps); fully offline once cached
mapFeaturesList.trailStyle: Trail style - choose how the route polyline is coloured from the layers panel: Default (single colour), Sections (A/B/C zones with boundary markers and per-section stats), Grade (Strava-style gradient tinting with five bands; warm for ascents and cool for descents in the active travel direction; colour-ramp legend in the panel; recomputed when the SOBO/NOBO direction is toggled), Surface, or Difficulty (SAC)
mapFeaturesList.surfaceAndSac: Surface and difficulty colouring - tint the trail polyline (and the elevation chart's area fill) by OSM surface type (paved / unpaved / gravel / ground / rock) or by SAC hiking scale (T1 hiking through T6 difficult alpine hiking). The data is enriched monthly from OpenStreetMap by a GitHub Action; surface and SAC options stay disabled until the dataset finishes loading on first paint. Direction-aware: the dataset is keyed to SOBO km and the renderer mirrors to NOBO on the fly
mapFeaturesList.distanceMarkers: Distance markers - small km / mi labels along the trail at 100 / 50 / 25 / 10 / 5 / 1 unit intervals. Progressive disclosure by zoom level: 100 km always visible at any zoom, finer intervals reveal as you zoom in (1 km labels only at zoom 13+). Toggleable from Settings; labels follow the active unit system and current direction (SOBO/NOBO)
mapFeaturesList.pois: Points of interest, list and search - around 7,700 places along the trail (towns, settlements, peaks, viewpoints, mountain huts, shelters, food, and ATMs) inside the Croatian border. Per-type filters in the layers panel; per-tag filters, saved named filter presets, multiple named starred lists, and an include-remote-POIs toggle in the list panel. Markers cluster at country zoom and split out as you zoom in. Popups carry a multi-image photo gallery (Wikimedia Commons, with per-image attribution and licence; tap any thumbnail for a fullscreen lightbox with keyboard navigation), a Wikipedia summary that appears immediately (baked at enrichment time for the popular places, lazy-fetched for the rest), a provenance footer that tells you where the data came from and when it was last verified, and a Copy link button that deep-links straight to the place. The list panel sorts by trail km, name, off-trail distance, or Near me when GPS is locked; an optional 50 km decade grouping turns the long list into chapters with sticky headers; full keyboard navigation. The multi-day stage planner shows how many places fall inside each daily stage, lists them in walking order, and can export every POI across the whole plan as a single GPX waypoint file. Imported GPX tracks can list the POIs you passed within 500 m, sorted in walking order. Search by name (diacritic-folded) or by km to jump to a point. Pre-cached corridor downloads also pull POI thumbnails and Wikipedia summaries so popups stay rich offline. Dataset is refreshed monthly from OpenStreetMap, Wikidata, Wikimedia Commons, and the HPS hut directory; the enricher is failure-resilient so a single bad day at one upstream service can never silently degrade the dataset
mapFeaturesList.tripBrief: Trip brief export - one-click printable brief (PDF for print, DOCX for editing) generated from your multi-day stage plan. Each day gets its own page with a map snapshot, a templated narrative, places along the way (name, type, trail km, photos, Wikipedia summary), and any seasonal-status alerts that intersect the day's range. The back page bundles emergency guidance: 112 dial, HGSS request format, and field essentials. Localised to en / hr / de / it. Optional AI-written day narratives (generated from the plan's own facts, online only, with an accuracy disclaimer); templated text remains the default and the automatic fallback
mapFeaturesList.offRouteAlert: Off-route alert - optional warning (off by default) when you drift more than 200 m from the trail: a banner with your distance and compass bearing back, plus vibration. Arms itself only after GPS places you on the trail, so it stays silent elsewhere in Croatia, and auto-disarms when you genuinely leave (bus, taxi, end of day)
mapFeaturesList.waterIntelligence: Water source intelligence - every water place carries a reliability class from OSM ground-truth tags: reliable tap, seasonal (may be dry), unverified spring (treat before drinking), or not drinkable. The class colours the marker, shows as a badge in popups and lists, and the stage planner flags days whose longest stretch without usable water exceeds 15 / 25 km
mapFeaturesList.completionTracking: Section completion tracking - mark stretches hiked from GPS, the ruler, whole A/B/C sections, or imported GPX. The progress panel (checkmark) uses grouped cards, a sticky animated summary, and collapsible waypoint/journal sections; completed stretches draw green on the map
mapFeaturesList.helpPanel: In-app help - the ? button opens a topic-grouped reference covering map basics, the elevation chart, hidden gestures (SOS long-press, GPX drag-and-drop), planning tools, and offline behaviour
mapFeaturesList.upNext: Up next data-book view - the nearest water source, shelter, and town ahead of you, with distances, right in the distance panel. Optional food, ATM, viewpoint, and pharmacy rows in Settings.
mapFeaturesList.packWeight: Pack weight & water carry - per-stage "carry up to X L" suggestions from your base weight and drinking rate, in metric or imperial
mapFeaturesList.waypointsJournal: Custom waypoints & trip journal - long-press the map for personal markers with notes; dated journal entries can attach a ruler stretch or link an imported GPX segment (map preview, View and overflow menu for show on map / GPX / zip bundle). Markdown and share URLs round-trip track refs; all stored on your device
mapFeaturesList.resupply: Town resupply guides - shops, pharmacies, ATMs, post and bus info from OpenStreetMap in town popups, with per-stage resupply chips in the planner
mapFeaturesList.pushAlerts: Trail alert notifications - optional browser push when a new seasonal warning or trail condition notice is published, even with the app closed; no account needed

about.dataAttributionDesc: Trail data is provided by the Udruga Long Distance Trail Hrvatska (LDTH) organization. Map tiles come from OpenStreetMap, OpenTopoMap, OpenHikingMap (openmaps.fr), CyclOSM, Waymarked Trails, and other providers. Croatian topographic maps are from the State Geodetic Administration (DGU). Weather data comes from DHMZ (Croatian Met Service) and Open-Meteo. Radar tiles are provided by RainViewer. Seasonal trail status, hazard warnings, and mountain rescue station data are sourced from HGSS (Croatian Mountain Rescue Service), HPS (Croatian Mountaineering Federation), and the national park authorities (NP Plitvička jezera, NP Sjeverni Velebit, NP Paklenica, NP Krka) together with Park prirode Velebit. Data displayed on this site may not reflect the latest conditions. When in doubt, always verify with the official sources.
about.privacyDesc: Your location is used only when you enable it and grant permission. Core map browsing and GPS progress stay in your browser. Optional online features (share link shortening, trip brief AI, SOS address lookup) may send coordinates or plan data to our server or third parties. No account or login is required.
about.officialAppDesc: The official mobile app of the CLDT is <link>FarOut</link>, published in cooperation with the trail association. {title} is an independent project and should be used for research and educational purposes only - always cross-check critical information (water, hazards, closures) with official sources before relying on it in the field.
about.demoCalloutDesc: Walk the trail at about 4 km/h with sample waypoints, a journal entry, and progress tracking - no GPS needed.

storeTest.title: Store playground
storeTest.offRouteDescription: Drives the real alert banner by injecting synthetic GPS fixes (user location + closest trail point) into the stores. Enable the feature, send 3 on-trail fixes to arm the machine, then 3 off-trail fixes to raise the alert. A far fix exercises auto-disarm; an inaccurate fix should change nothing.

storeTest.offRouteSnoozedHint: No banner while the phase is alerting means it was dismissed; it stays snoozed until the alert resolves and a new drift occurs.

walk.description: A fake hiker that moves along the trail and feeds the same store paths as real GPS. Start it here, then open the map and watch the tooltip, HUD, auto-track progress, banners, and off-route alert react. Keeps walking while you navigate.

gpxDownload.disclaimerIntro: Welcome to the Croatian Long Distance Trail GPX download section! Here you can download the GPS track and explore it on the interactive map. Please note the following:
gpxDownload.disclaimerItem1: The trail is currently under construction.
gpxDownload.disclaimerItem2: The main navigation tool is still the FarOut mobile app.
gpxDownload.disclaimerItem3: The public GPX file does not contain waypoints, which are essential for trail navigation. These are available within the FarOut mobile app.
gpxDownload.disclaimerItem4: The only official GPX file is available on our website.
gpxDownload.disclaimerItem5: We cannot guarantee the accuracy of tracks downloaded from other sources.
gpxDownload.disclaimerItem6: Our website will always have the most up-to-date version of the track.
gpxDownload.disclaimerItem7: Use of the track is at your own risk.
gpxDownload.disclaimerItem8: The Udruga Long Distance Trail Hrvatska disclaims any liability in the event of accidents while using the GPX record and visiting the trail.
gpxDownload.disclaimerItem9: Resale and use of the CLDT GPX file for financial gain is a criminal offence and is subject to prosecution.
gpxDownload.acknowledgmentLabel: I am aware of the possible dangers on the trail and will explore and use it responsibly, respecting the Leave No Trace principles.

basics.layers: The layers button (top right) switches base maps, overlays like radar and severe weather, trail colouring styles, and POI categories.
basics.trail: Tap the trail line, POI markers, or seasonal warning chips for details; popups link onward to photos, Wikipedia, and sharing.
basics.settings: The gear holds units, direction (SOBO/NOBO), walking pace, dark mode, and per-feature toggles.
basics.share: The share button opens a panel with a QR code for your current map link (scan from another phone) and a copy link button. Needs GPS or a pinned trail point. Short links apply when online and enabled in Settings.

gestures.sos: Long-press the red SOS button for the offline emergency panel: coordinates, Plus Code, nearest road access, HGSS rescue, one-tap 112, and an online address line when available.
gestures.gpxDrop: Drag and drop a recorded .gpx file anywhere onto the map to overlay your hike and compare it with the official trail.
gestures.poiList: In the places list, type a number ("100 km") to jump there; arrow keys navigate, S selects rows for GPX export. Save filter presets and star places into named lists (trip brief "selected only" uses the active list).
gestures.waypoint: Long-press (or right-click) anywhere on the map to drop a personal waypoint with a note.

planning.planner: The calendar button splits any trail range into daily stages with elevation, ETA, water, and weather per day.
planning.tripBrief: Inside the planner, "Trip brief" exports a printable PDF or editable DOCX of the whole plan with maps and emergency info.
planning.progress: The checkmark button tracks which stretches you have hiked - automatically from GPS, from the ruler selection, or from an imported track. The panel groups Your progress, From GPX, waypoints, and journal in cards with a sticky animated summary.
planning.journal: In the journal section, link an imported GPX segment to a dated entry (link icon), preview it on the map, View read-only entries, or use the overflow menu to export GPX, a zip bundle, or remove the link. Markdown import/export preserves range and track metadata in HTML comments; share URLs carry track refs when trip state is included.
planning.packWeight: Set your pack weight in Settings to get per-stage water carry suggestions and weight-adjusted ETAs; import a LighterPack/Packstack CSV to fill it automatically.
planning.resupply: Town popups list nearby shops and services; a cart chip in the stage planner warns when a stage has no grocery resupply.

offline.precache: The cache panel pre-downloads the whole trail corridor (tiles, places, photos) for use without signal; it re-syncs on Wi-Fi.
offline.gps: GPS, the emergency panel, and your progress keep working fully offline once the corridor is cached.
offline.offRouteAlert: Enable the off-route alert in Settings (off by default) for a banner and vibration when you drift more than ~200 m from the trail, with distance and bearing back. Arms only after GPS confirms you are on the trail; stays silent at home or while driving, and disarms when you leave the trail area.
offline.pushAlerts: Enable trail alert notifications in Settings to get a push when a new seasonal warning or trail condition notice is published.

help.officialAppNote: FarOut is the official CLDT app. This map is an independent project for research and educational purposes only - verify critical information with official sources.
help.demoDesc: Try a simulated mid-trail hike with sample waypoints and progress - no GPS needed.
